verses.text: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.

segments.text: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.

verses.text: Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.

segments.text: Come before his presence with singing.

verses.text: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us, and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

segments.text: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God:
It is he that hath made us, and we are his;
We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.

segments.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
And into his courts with praise:
Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.

verses.text: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness endureth for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.

segments.text: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness
And his faithfulness unto all generations.
